name: Radial Gaussian Density Field Generation
definition: Generates a 3D scalar field for volume rendering by summing normalized radial Gaussian functions centered at predefined atomic positions, then scaling and clamping the result to a [0,1] range.
summary: Radial Gaussian Density Field Generation creates a 3D scalar density field by summing static, smooth Gaussian falloffs centered on fixed atomic positions, differing from dynamic metaball fields.
